name: aria-tool-selection-accuracy
description: Evaluates whether ARIA chose the appropriate MCP tool for each situation.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Optimal tool selected for this exact situation.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Correct tool selected; minor inefficiency such as a redundant call.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Acceptable tool but not the best choice for the situation.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Wrong tool category selected, causing incorrect or incomplete result.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely wrong tool; would cause errors or data leakage.
